set.body:
Objective
Close the implementation epic only after the claim-by-claim qualification report, migration/removal evidence and reproducible JVM/JS execution receipts are complete.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements NUM-01, OPS-01, PERF-02, GRP-02, INF-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
independent release audit; qualified release report; scenario harness; affected module test/compile and dependency gates. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M5.04, M5.05, M5.06, M4. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Every PRD requirement has accepted evidence or an explicit approved scope amendment; not-tested and known failures cannot count as clean Pass.
2. Recheck exact adopted source/provider pins, all three vertical slices, legacy absence, artifact interpretation and cross-platform warning-clean compilation.
3. Run bounded JVM/JS sbt batches under AGENTS.md; record commands, revisions, seeds, resource limits, caveats and actual outputs.
4. Separate semantic, numerical, protocol, resource and scientific evidence; approval of this report does not itself publish a release or push Git.

Verification
Run sbt scalafimCompileAll and all affected JVM and Scala.js suites in bounded, separate sbt batches. Never run scalafimTestAll as one long VM job. Reproduce the frozen scientific/resource protocols and archive exact receipts; compile success alone does not qualify science.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M5.07: Assemble the independent qualified-release evidence and final portability gate
